The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) indicated that it is still working to make changes in federal agencies, including cutting government credit card accounts.
A program that was introduced earlier this year has resulted in the cancellation of more than 610,000 unused or unneeded federal credit cards after 14 weeks, DOGE
said
in a post on social media platform X on June 6.
